messages:
Amanda: Hey team — quick Q on PartnerX marketplace Terraform modules. What are the absolute-minimum validation checks we require to get a starter kit accepted by the marketplace QA? Trying to get this through this week, cc @Jorge

Jorge: Short list that usually blocks: registry layout (modules/<name>), license + NOTICE, clear README with usage example, CI that runs a smoke deploy (can be a lightweight terratest), module inputs have sane defaults, outputs for endpoints, and a small example overlay that actually provisions and verifies resources. Also metadata file for the marketplace (yaml/json) — do you have the repo link?

Amanda: repo: github.com/redwood-partners/partnerx-llm-iac (private)
structure snippet:
```
modules/partnerx-refkit/
  main.tf
  variables.tf
  outputs.tf
examples/simple/
  example.tf
README.md
marketplace.yaml
```
Is that enough to start QA?

Kevin: That layout looks fine. Add a simple GH action that does:
- terraform fmt + validate
- terraform init + plan (against a small test workspace)
- run terratest/Golang smoke if you can
You can also run checkov for security policy gates. Quick GH action example:
```yaml
name: iac-checks
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: terraform fmt
        run: terraform fmt -check
      - name: terraform init+plan
        run: terraform init && terraform plan -var-file=examples/simple/vars.tfvars
```

Priya: Marketplace metadata: we need the marketplace.yaml to include `publisher`, `supported_regions`, `pricing_tier` and `hardware_profile` (e.g., ampere/x86) — otherwise it fails the ingestion job. Also ensure the README mentions expected sequence length and recommended instance types.

Jorge: One more gotcha — outputs must include a stable `endpoint_url` or `console_link` that our validation script can curl. If the example deploys behind a LB, the smoke test should assert a 200 on /health. If you can't provision public IPs for QA, provide a mocked validation hook (script that returns success) and mark it in marketplace.yaml as `mockable: true` so partners can manually audit.

Amanda: Great, thanks. I'll add: README usage + tiny example that returns /health, GH action with plan, marketplace.yaml fields, and an outputs.tf with endpoint_url. Will aim to push by EOD.

Kevin: I'll pair on the smoke test tomorrow morning, @Amanda. I can add a tiny terratest that runs `terraform apply` in a disposable workspace and hits /health. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI pipeline quickref-iac (branch: feature/marketplace-fix) — lint & plan succeeded (jobs: lint, plan)

Amanda: Awesome, thanks all. If marketplace ingestion flags anything I'll drop it here and @Priya can escalate.

Jorge: Thanks — ping when pushed and I'll run the ingestion script locally.

Priya: Happy to review metadata after push. Good luck! :rocket:
